text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's natural, but it's not enough.
It doesn't come close to satisfying me.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in a way that's more thrilling—that makes my heart burst with excitement!
No, I have to!
choice_data_list: With that positive attitude, you'll be just fine!
Shall we take a close look at the areas for improvement?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: “At the same time, though, I know I've got plenty of room for improvement.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
My ideal is to run at the very front,
and win straight and head-on!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"So, let's keep piling on
more and more training, okay!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah. We'll crush the issues we've identified and put what we've gained to good use next time.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Just a suggestion, but why don't we
make the training menu way tougher?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Because next time, I definitely want to take 1st place.
